body:

title: Ban dispute for Iamc4sp3r and xLegendC

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello xLegendC,

Your brother only joined very recently, after you were banned. Furthermore your logs indicate that it is indeed you ban evading and not your older brother. Even if the account is your brothers, the logs give the impression that you have used it to evade a punishment. If he really is your brother then provide sufficient proof but as for now this appeal is denied. 

Regards, 

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
